NOT established: the order of items 2, 3 and 5 among themselves (means 3.669 / 3.608 / 3.642, correlations with every other GQS block within noise, no published per-item statistics). Item 1 'Dead <-> Alive' is separately consistent with its distinctly lower mean (3.216) and its much higher loading on the anthropomorphism block (0.567-0.653 vs 0.316-0.486 for items 2-5), but that is semantic, not decisive. Hence PARTIAL, not VERIFIED.
